title: Stalk-normalized closed-point continuous tangent compatibility
statement: For a scheme $X$ over a field $k$, use the tangent identification of [def-sfb-proper-scheme-tangent-data]. Equip $A_x=\mathcal O_{X,x}$ with the existing structural field map to the stalk [lem-sfb-isolated-curve-formal-lifting]. A stalk comparison is the exact additive module-stalk functor [def-pc-module-stalk-functor] together with the derived isomorphism from the stalk of the full standard sheaf cotangent complex to $L_{A_x/k}$, normalized on every polynomial differential section by the germ ring square. Its structural coefficient isomorphism takes ring germs to the same germs. The induced Ext map is exact stalk applied to the derived morphism, followed by the canonical shift and single-object comparisons and this normalized coefficient map. A marked algebra deformation is the stalk of a scheme deformation when it has a ring isomorphism to the actual stalk at the marked point, carrying the scalar map to its structural germ and the marking to the marking stalk map [def-sfb-marked-flat-algebra-deformations]. Closed-completion compatibility provides these stalk comparisons at every closed point, the completed tangent comparisons of [def-sfb-completed-scheme-tangent-data] for every finite localized polynomial presentation, and existence of actual stalk representatives. The naive comparison of [lem-trf-lci-naive-cotangent-model] is surjective on Ext-one representatives. For every scheme lift, every actual stalk representative and every naive Ext representative of the stalk of its global tangent class, the completed class of the stalk has the scalar-extended Ext representative. This is the square from global tangent classes through stalk and completion to the continuous completed conormal Ext group, pinned on actual germs and relations. The local algebra ring arrow is the actual affine arrow of [def-sfb-affine-scheme-deformation-comparison].
